premise: When ancient subterranean fissures flood Earth with mutagenic miasma, archivist Arthur Vance uses encyclopedic science, bio-enhancements, and modular engineering to rescue his sister Eleanor and survive ruthless mutant warlords—while ridiculous coincidences constantly rob him of the credit.
central_conflict: Arthur Vance & Survivor Convoy vs. Mutated Warlords (Ironfang Marcus Cole) & Subterranean Primordial Leviathans
protagonist_goal: Synthesize permanent stabilizing cure for sister Eleanor and secure Blackwood Ridge Bunker 07 research sanctuary.
ultimate_antagonistic_force: The Subterranean Void Primordials and Mutant Warlord Cabals
central_stakes: Extinction of unmutated humanity and Eleanor fatal sovereign resonance collapse.
thematic_question: Can human intellect and meticulous craftsmanship triumph over brutal biological godhood?
desired_ending: Arthur establishes an unassailable technological sanctuary, cures Eleanor, and uncovers the ancient First Dynasty anchors.
